packet.verseText: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Four strange winged creatures, each covered with eyes, standing close around the central throne.
scene.action: They stand still in quiet vigil, eyes turned outward and inward, as light radiates from the throne.
scene.setting: A vast heavenly throne room, its floor a clear sea of glass like crystal reflecting the radiance.
scene.secondaryElements: Radiance and rainbow-green glow flowing from the central throne across the glassy sea; a faint cloud of light around the throne, with no visible form within it.
scene.mood: Awe-filled, holy stillness and reverent wonder.
scene.timeOfDay: Timeless heavenly light, clear and calm with no storm or change.
scene.composition: Wide view from slightly below, the creatures framing the throne at the center with the glassy sea spreading in the foreground.

packet.verseText: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Isaiah standing below in a plain tunic and cloak, face lifted upward, and the seraphim hovering above him with wings spread.
scene.action: The seraphim hover in the air, two wings veiling their faces, two veiling their feet, two beating to lift them.
scene.setting: High temple hall of cedar and stone with a tall doorway and incense haze drifting through the space.
scene.secondaryElements: Radiant light and cloud spread through the upper hall from beyond the frame, smoke rising from the altar, the threshold of the doorway trembling.
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and quiet trembling before a holy presence.
scene.timeOfDay: Hushed twilight with sacred lamplight against the last of the day, air still and windless.
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from behind Isaiah looking up toward the seraphim hovering in the upper hall, the presence shown only as light and cloud.

packet.verseText: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

availableCast.name: David son of Jesse (king of Israel)

scene.primarySubject: Young David, slight and tunic-clad, his arm still extended after the sling's release.
scene.action: Goliath, armored and massive, collapses face-first to the ground as the stone takes effect.
scene.setting: Open dry valley floor of Elah, scrub and stone, with hillside lines of armies and the city of Gath in the distance.
scene.secondaryElements: Bronze-helmeted Philistine soldiers frozen in shock at the front of their ranks; Israelite soldiers on the opposite slope; dust rising from the fallen giant; a shepherd's leather bag at David's side.
scene.mood: Tense, astonished stillness that gives way to quiet awe and a hint of grief.
scene.timeOfDay: Late morning, bright and clear, with dry still air stirred only by dust.
scene.composition: Wide valley view from a low angle, David small in the foreground-center facing the falling Goliath, armies arrayed on both hillsides.

God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Moses on the shore, arm extended over the water with his staff in hand
scene.action: Strong east wind drives the sea back, leaving dry ground and two towering walls of water
scene.setting: Shore of the Red Sea opening into a dry sea-floor between standing waters, wilderness sand on the near bank
scene.secondaryElements: Israelite people with bundles and staves gathered on the bank at a distance, distant Egyptian chariot tracks in the sand, spray and sand swept by the wind, cloud-light pouring through the parted waters, a pillar of cloud and fire spread across the sky
scene.mood: Awe, tense anticipation and quiet dignity amid the wind
scene.timeOfDay: Night deepening toward pale grey pre-dawn, dark clouds high above the parted waters
scene.composition: Wide view from the shore, Moses in the foreground-left with outstretched arm, the parted sea receding into the center, the people small on the far bank

packet.verseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

availableCast.name: David son of Jesse (king of Israel)

scene.primarySubject: A flock of sheep resting on lush green grass beside still water
scene.action: The sheep lie down contentedly in the grass as the day cools
scene.setting: Open green pastures and a calm pool of still water in the hill country of ancient Judah
scene.secondaryElements: A shepherd's stone enclosure and distant village walls on the rise, with a staff and sling left propped on a rock nearby
scene.mood: Peaceful, restful and trusting
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon into evening, clear and calm with soft drifting clouds
scene.composition: Wide landscape view with the sheep in the foreground lying in grass, the still water at midground and the hills stretching behind

packet.verseText: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.

scene.primarySubject: An older man in plain undyed tunic seated, listening with calm attention, no infant present
scene.action: A quiet, settled gathering of family members hearing the lineage recited, the moment unfolding as a steady continuity rather than an event
scene.setting: Interior courtyard of a mud-brick house in Bethlehem, with a doorway open to sunlight and a simple stone or clay bench
scene.secondaryElements: Blank, rolled or closed scroll resting on a low table; a few unnamed household members seated nearby, quietly attentive
scene.mood: Calm, reverent continuity, dignified and grounded
scene.timeOfDay: Warm afternoon in clear, dry Judean sunshine with a light breeze
scene.composition: Medium shot from the courtyard threshold, the seated figures placed in the lower centre with the open doorway framing soft golden light behind

packet.verseText: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Four strange winged creatures, each covered with eyes, standing close around the central throne.
scene.action: They stand still in quiet vigil, eyes turned outward and inward, as light radiates from the throne.
scene.setting: A vast heavenly throne room, its floor a clear sea of glass like crystal reflecting the radiance.
scene.secondaryElements: Radiance and rainbow-green glow flowing from the central throne across the glassy sea; a faint cloud of light around the throne, with no visible form within it.
scene.mood: Awe-filled, holy stillness and reverent wonder.
scene.timeOfDay: Timeless heavenly light, clear and calm with no storm or change.
scene.composition: Wide view from slightly below, the creatures framing the throne at the center with the glassy sea spreading in the foreground.

packet.verseText: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Isaiah standing below in a plain tunic and cloak, face lifted upward, and the seraphim hovering above him with wings spread.
scene.action: The seraphim hover in the air, two wings veiling their faces, two veiling their feet, two beating to lift them.
scene.setting: High temple hall of cedar and stone with a tall doorway and incense haze drifting through the space.
scene.secondaryElements: Radiant light and cloud spread through the upper hall from beyond the frame, smoke rising from the altar, the threshold of the doorway trembling.
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and quiet trembling before a holy presence.
scene.timeOfDay: Hushed twilight with sacred lamplight against the last of the day, air still and windless.
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from behind Isaiah looking up toward the seraphim hovering in the upper hall, the presence shown only as light and cloud.

packet.verseText: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.

scene.primarySubject: An older man in plain undyed tunic seated, listening with calm attention, no infant present

packet.verseText: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

availableCast.name: Jesus Christ, the Son of God and Lord

scene.primarySubject: Roman soldiers kneeling and casting lots at the foot of the cross
scene.action: A soldier shakes or tosses lots while others reach to claim the folded garments on the ground.
scene.setting: Rocky hilltop of Golgotha outside Jerusalem's stone walls, with the cross rising above
scene.secondaryElements: Crumpled tunic and cloak spread on the stones; a few onlookers at a distance; the crossbeam and figure of Jesus seen above, kept in restrained shadow
scene.mood: Solemn, detached, grim; a quiet gravity in the soldiers' routine
scene.timeOfDay: Midday turning to afternoon; hot still air and sky darkening with heavy cloud
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from the side, soldiers in the foreground with the cross and dark sky rising behind them

packet.verseText: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

scene.primarySubject: A rolled scroll resting on a sunlit stone wall, its edges weathered and its ends tied with plain cord.
scene.action: Stillness; the scroll lies waiting while a light breeze stirs the dust of the road.
scene.setting: A stone village street with plain stone houses and a synagogue wall in Roman Judea, under a clear sky.
scene.secondaryElements: A few undyed wool cloaks hanging on a doorpost, a clay oil lamp and a small pile of papyrus sheets beside the scroll, and a dry hillside visible beyond the rooftops.
scene.mood: Quiet, dignified anticipation and a sense of lineage carried in ordinary things.
scene.timeOfDay: Midday, clear and dry with warm, even Mediterranean sunlight and soft shadows.
scene.composition: Low, near-eye-level view along the street, with the scroll placed in the foreground on the wall and the village receding into the distance.

packet.verseText: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

availableCast.name: Jesus Christ, the Son of God and Lord

scene.primarySubject: Jesus standing at the tomb mouth, arm raised, face lifted in a loud command
scene.action: Jesus calls out in a loud voice toward the dark tomb; Lazarus is still within, not yet emerged
scene.setting: Rock-cut tomb entrance on a hillside outside Bethany with the stone rolled aside
scene.secondaryElements: Martha kneeling or standing near with hands clasped, a gathered crowd of mourners in Judean dress at a respectful distance, the dark tomb opening empty of visible movement
scene.mood: Solemn expectancy, awe and hushed tension before a miracle
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon turning toward dusk, clear still air, warm low sun from the west with long soft shadows
scene.composition: Wide view from the tomb's outer side, Jesus and the tomb opening central, crowd arranged in a loose arc behind and to the sides

packet.verseText: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

availableCast.name: David son of Jesse (king of Israel)

scene.primarySubject: Young David, slight and tunic-clad, his arm still extended after the sling's release.
scene.action: Goliath, armored and massive, collapses face-first to the ground as the stone takes effect.
scene.setting: Open dry valley floor of Elah, scrub and stone, with hillside lines of armies and the city of Gath in the distance.
scene.secondaryElements: Bronze-helmeted Philistine soldiers frozen in shock at the front of their ranks; Israelite soldiers on the opposite slope; dust rising from the fallen giant; a shepherd's leather bag at David's side.
scene.mood: Tense, astonished stillness that gives way to quiet awe and a hint of grief.
scene.timeOfDay: Late morning, bright and clear, with dry still air stirred only by dust.
scene.composition: Wide valley view from a low angle, David small in the foreground-center facing the falling Goliath, armies arrayed on both hillsides.

packet.verseText: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Brilliant light and radiant cloud breaking open over the dark waters, with no figure or shape within it.
scene.action: Light spreads outward from beyond the frame, pushing back the darkness as it first touches the misty surface of the deep.
scene.setting: Wild, formless primordial waters under a dark void, with mist hanging low and the first dry ground just emerging at the edges.
scene.secondaryElements: Dark churning water surface catching the first glow, mist lifting in pale bands, the faint outline of distant shore or dry ground; no people, creatures, or objects.
scene.mood: Awe and solemn hush, a sense of beginning and grandeur without spectacle.
scene.timeOfDay: Primordial darkness giving way to first light; still, misty air with a heavy hush.
scene.composition: Wide, low viewpoint over the water, with the light entering from the upper or far side and the dark deep filling the lower frame.
